name: gstack
description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
one_liner: A free, ready-made set of slash commands that turns one person's AI coding assistant into a whole pretend engineering team — a product manager, a designer, a reviewer, a QA tester — all built in.
buyer: A non-technical or first-time founder who wants to ship a real product with an AI coding assistant but has no engineering team and no idea how to structure the process.
business_use_cases: A solo-founder coaching service uses this free toolkit as the backbone of a paid 'ship your MVP in 30 days' program for non-technical founders.
An indie-hacker community charges for office hours/templates layered on top of a free tool like this, since the tool itself is given away by a famous investor.
A bootcamp for non-technical founders builds a curriculum around structured AI-agent workflows like this one.

money_ideas.idea: Paid coaching or cohort program teaching non-technical founders to ship with an AI-agent 'team' workflow.
Done-for-you setup and customization of the workflow for a founder's specific product, billed as a small project fee.

steal_this: Don't compete with a free tool backed by a famous VC's name — instead, sell the thing it can't give away: a weekend of 1:1 hands-on setup and coaching for a non-technical founder using it.
